description: A constituent's memberships: level, start date and finish date — use it to see whether someone is current or lapsed. LGL: GET /api/v1/constituents/{constituent_id}/memberships.

limit.description: Number of entries to return, 1-100. LGL's default is 25.

offset.description: Start at this entry (0-based). Use the previous page's next_item. Default 0.

name: lgl_list_constituent_memberships
title: List a constituent's memberships
